MTCNN face detection with DeepFace emotion recognition. Supports webcam, video files, and RTSP streams with real-time processing.

🎤 Speech Transcription

OpenAI Whisper integration for accurate speech-to-text with temporal alignment to facial expressions for behavioral analysis.

🔍 Mismatch Detection

Automated detection of speech-emotion inconsistencies with severity scoring and confidence metrics for analyst review.

Comprehensive PDF reports with visualizations, chain of custody, and executive summaries for operational use.

Air-gapped operation, tamper-evident audit logging, metadata stripping, and complete local processing.

ARIA-compliant GUI with keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and professional styling for operational environments.

Download & Installation

This system requires local installation on authorized workstations

Python 3.8+
Required runtime environment
~2GB RAM
For AI model processing

Installation Instructions

# 1. Clone or download the project files
# 2. Create Python virtual environment
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate

# 3. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 4. Run the application
python launch_gui.py  # GUI interface
python app.py --help  # CLI interface

# 5. First run will download AI models (~300MB)

System Requirements

  • Operating System: Windows 10+, macOS 10.14+, Linux (Ubuntu 18.04+)
  • Python: 3.8 or higher
  • Memory: 4GB RAM minimum, 8GB recommended
  • Storage: 2GB free space for models and processing
  • Graphics: OpenCV-compatible display adapter
  • Camera: USB webcam or integrated camera (optional)
  • Network: Internet connection for initial model download only
